title: Ujian Kelulusan A2.1: Evaluasi Komprehensif Tindakan Dasar
objective: Ujian kelulusan komprehensif 4 keterampilan (Listening, Reading, Writing, Speaking) untuk membuka Sub-Level A2.2

theory.summary: Ujian kelulusan A2.1 ini menguji kemampuan Anda dalam mendengarkan, membaca, menulis, dan berbicara dalam bahasa Inggris tingkat dasar. Anda akan diuji pada berbagai tata bahasa yang telah dipelajari: present tenses (simple & continuous), past simple, past continuous, quantifiers (too/enough), comparatives, have to, future dengan will, modals of advice (should/shouldn't), first conditional, dan present perfect dengan ever/never. Ujian ini dirancang untuk memastikan Anda siap melanjutkan ke level A2.2. Nilai kelulusan minimal adalah 75. Percaya diri dan tunjukkan kemampuan terbaik Anda!
rules: Present Simple vs Present Continuous: Gunakan present simple untuk kebiasaan (I work every day) dan present continuous untuk aksi sedang berlangsung (I'm working now).
Past Simple vs Past Continuous: Past simple untuk aksi selesai di masa lalu (I went to school), past continuous untuk aksi sedang berlangsung di masa lalu (I was studying when you called).
First Conditional: Formula If + present simple, will + verb (If it rains, I will stay home) untuk situasi nyata di masa depan.
Present Perfect dengan Ever/Never: Formula have/has + past participle untuk pengalaman hidup (Have you ever visited London? / I have never eaten sushi).
Comparatives: Tambahkan -er untuk kata sifat pendek (faster, bigger) atau more untuk kata sifat panjang (more beautiful, more expensive).
Have to/Don't have to: Have to menunjukkan kewajiban (I have to finish homework), don't have to menunjukkan tidak wajib (You don't have to come).
Modals of Advice: Should untuk saran positif (You should study), shouldn't untuk saran negatif (You shouldn't eat too much sugar).
Too/Enough: Too berarti terlalu (too expensive), enough berarti cukup dan diletakkan setelah kata sifat (good enough) atau sebelum kata benda (enough money).

commonTrap.explanation: Siswa level A2 sering mengacaukan penggunaan present perfect dengan past simple. Present perfect digunakan untuk pengalaman tanpa waktu spesifik, sedangkan past simple memerlukan waktu yang jelas. Kesalahan lain adalah menempatkan 'enough' di posisi yang salah.
commonTrap.wrong: I have visited Paris last year. / This bag is enough big.
commonTrap.correct: I visited Paris last year. (waktu spesifik) / I have visited Paris. (pengalaman umum) / This bag is big enough.

dialogue.context: Sarah sedang mendiskusikan hasil ujian kelulusan A2.1 dengan Mr. Khoirul setelah menyelesaikan ujian tersebut.

lines.speaker: Sarah
lines.text: Mr. Khoirul, I've just finished the A2.1 exam. It was quite challenging!
lines.translation: Pak Khoirul, saya baru saja menyelesaikan ujian A2.1. Cukup menantang!

lines.speaker: Mr. Khoirul
lines.text: Well done, Sarah! Which section did you find the most difficult?
lines.translation: Bagus sekali, Sarah! Bagian mana yang menurutmu paling sulit?

lines.speaker: Sarah
lines.text: The listening comprehension was tricky. I had to listen very carefully to catch all the details.
lines.translation: Pemahaman mendengarkan agak rumit. Saya harus mendengarkan dengan sangat hati-hati untuk menangkap semua detailnya.

lines.speaker: Mr. Khoirul
lines.text: That's normal. Listening requires a lot of concentration. How about the grammar section?
lines.translation: Itu wajar. Mendengarkan memerlukan banyak konsentrasi. Bagaimana dengan bagian tata bahasa?

lines.speaker: Sarah
lines.text: The grammar was okay. I've practiced present perfect and conditionals a lot, so I felt confident.
lines.translation: Tata bahasanya lumayan. Saya sudah banyak berlatih present perfect dan conditional, jadi saya merasa percaya diri.

lines.speaker: Mr. Khoirul
lines.text: Excellent! Remember, you need 75% to pass to A2.2. I'm sure you'll do great.
lines.translation: Bagus sekali! Ingat, kamu butuh 75% untuk lulus ke A2.2. Saya yakin kamu akan berhasil.

lines.speaker: Sarah
lines.text: Thank you, Mr. Khoirul. When will I get the results?
lines.translation: Terima kasih, Pak Khoirul. Kapan saya akan mendapat hasilnya?

lines.speaker: Mr. Khoirul
lines.text: You'll receive your detailed results immediately after submitting. Good luck!
lines.translation: Kamu akan menerima hasil detailmu segera setelah mengirimkan. Semoga berhasil!

speakingLab.context: Anda sedang melakukan sesi latihan berbicara final dengan Mr. Khoirul sebelum mengambil ujian kelulusan A2.1. Mr. Khoirul akan menanyakan beberapa pertanyaan untuk membantu Anda berlatih.

turns.speaker: Mr. Khoirul
turns.text: Hello! Are you ready for your A2.1 final exam? How are you feeling about it?

turns.speaker: You
turns.text: Hi, Mr. Khoirul! I'm a little nervous, but I've been studying hard.

turns.speaker: Mr. Khoirul
turns.text: That's great to hear! Tell me, what grammar topic have you practiced the most?

turns.speaker: You
turns.text: I've practiced present perfect and first conditional the most because they were challenging for me.

turns.speaker: Mr. Khoirul
turns.text: Good choice! Now, can you give me an example of a first conditional sentence?

turns.speaker: You
turns.text: Sure! If I study hard, I will pass the exam.

turns.speaker: Mr. Khoirul
turns.text: Perfect! One last question: Have you ever taken a comprehensive English exam before?

turns.speaker: You
turns.text: No, I haven't. This is my first comprehensive exam, but I'm ready to do my best!

quiz.question: [Listening Comprehension] Audio Transcript: 'Hello, my name is Tom. I'm calling about the apartment for rent. Is it still available? I'm looking for a two-bedroom flat, and I need to move in next month. Could you tell me the monthly rent, please?' - What is Tom looking for?
quiz.explanation: Dalam transkrip audio, Tom dengan jelas menyatakan 'I'm looking for a two-bedroom flat', yang berarti dia mencari apartemen dengan dua kamar tidur. Ini adalah pertanyaan pemahaman mendengarkan langsung yang menguji kemampuan menangkap detail spesifik.

quiz.question: [Listening Comprehension] Audio Transcript: 'Last weekend was amazing! On Saturday morning, I was walking in the park when I met my old friend from university. We hadn't seen each other for five years! We went to a café and talked for hours.' - What was the speaker doing when she met her friend?
options: She was sitting in a café
She was walking in the park
quiz.answer: She was walking in the park
quiz.explanation: Pembicara menggunakan past continuous 'I was walking in the park' untuk menjelaskan aksi yang sedang berlangsung ketika dia bertemu temannya. Ini menguji pemahaman tentang penggunaan past continuous dalam konteks cerita masa lalu.

quiz.question: [Listening Comprehension] Audio Transcript: 'If you want to improve your English, you should practice every day. You shouldn't be afraid of making mistakes. I always tell my students: the more you practice, the better you'll become!' - According to the speaker, what should students NOT do?
quiz.explanation: Pembicara menggunakan modal 'shouldn't' untuk memberikan saran negatif: 'You shouldn't be afraid of making mistakes'. Pertanyaan ini menguji pemahaman tentang modals of advice dan kemampuan menangkap saran dalam konteks mendengarkan.

quiz.question: [Listening Comprehension] Audio Transcript: 'I have to finish this report by Friday because my boss needs it for the Monday meeting. I don't have to work on Saturday, so I'll have time to relax after I complete it.' - When does the speaker need to finish the report?
quiz.explanation: Pembicara dengan jelas menyatakan 'I have to finish this report by Friday', menunjukkan tenggat waktu yang spesifik. Pertanyaan ini menguji pemahaman tentang ekspresi kewajiban 'have to' dan kemampuan menangkap informasi waktu dalam listening.

quiz.question: [Reading Comprehension] Read the passage: 'Emma has lived in London for three years. She moved there from Manchester in 2023. She loves the city because it's bigger and more exciting than her hometown. However, she thinks Manchester is friendlier and the people are nicer. She has never regretted her decision to move, though.' - How long has Emma lived in London?
quiz.explanation: Kalimat pertama dengan jelas menyatakan 'Emma has lived in London for three years'. Meskipun 'since 2023' juga disebutkan, jawaban yang diminta adalah durasi waktu (for three years), bukan titik awal waktu. Ini menguji present perfect untuk durasi waktu.

quiz.question: [Reading Comprehension] Read the passage: 'Emma has lived in London for three years. She moved there from Manchester in 2023. She loves the city because it's bigger and more exciting than her hometown. However, she thinks Manchester is friendlier and the people are nicer. She has never regretted her decision to move, though.' - According to Emma, which city is friendlier?
quiz.explanation: Dalam teks, Emma menyatakan 'she thinks Manchester is friendlier and the people are nicer'. Ini adalah perbandingan langsung menggunakan comparative form. Pertanyaan ini menguji pemahaman membaca dan penggunaan comparatives.

quiz.question: [Reading Comprehension] Read the passage: 'The new restaurant on Main Street is too expensive for most students. A simple lunch costs around £15, which is not cheap enough for people on a budget. However, the food is delicious and the portions are big enough to share.' - Why is the restaurant not suitable for most students?
quiz.explanation: Kalimat pertama dengan jelas menyatakan 'The new restaurant on Main Street is too expensive for most students'. Kata 'too expensive' menunjukkan bahwa harga melebihi kemampuan mahasiswa. Ini menguji pemahaman penggunaan 'too' sebagai quantifier yang berarti berlebihan.

quiz.question: [Reading Comprehension] Read the passage: 'Climate change is affecting our planet in many ways. If we don't reduce carbon emissions, global temperatures will continue to rise. Scientists say we have to act now to protect the environment for future generations. Everyone should do their part by recycling and using less energy.' - According to the passage, what will happen if we don't reduce carbon emissions?
options: Global temperatures will continue to rise
quiz.answer: Global temperatures will continue to rise
quiz.explanation: Teks menggunakan first conditional: 'If we don't reduce carbon emissions, global temperatures will continue to rise'. Ini adalah contoh jelas dari struktur if-clause dengan prediksi masa depan. Pertanyaan ini menguji pemahaman first conditional dalam konteks reading.

quiz.question: [Writing & Grammar] Choose the correct sentence using present perfect with 'ever':
quiz.explanation: Present perfect dengan 'ever' digunakan untuk menanyakan pengalaman hidup dengan formula: Have/Has + subject + ever + past participle. Pilihan pertama salah karena mencampur past simple dengan 'ever', dan pilihan ketiga menggunakan present simple yang tidak tepat untuk konteks pengalaman.

quiz.question: [Writing & Grammar] Complete the sentence correctly: 'I ___ finish my homework before I can go out to play.'
quiz.explanation: Untuk menyatakan kewajiban, kita menggunakan 'have to' tanpa 'to' tambahan setelahnya. Formula: subject + have to + verb. 'Must to' dan 'should to' tidak benar karena modal verbs tidak diikuti oleh 'to' sebelum verb utama.

quiz.question: [Writing & Grammar] Which sentence uses past continuous correctly?
options: I watched TV when you called me.
I was watching TV when you called me.
I am watching TV when you called me.
quiz.answer: I was watching TV when you called me.
quiz.explanation: Past continuous (was/were + verb-ing) digunakan untuk menunjukkan aksi yang sedang berlangsung di masa lalu ketika aksi lain (past simple) terjadi. Formula: I was watching (past continuous) when you called (past simple). Ini adalah struktur standar untuk menggambarkan interrupted action.

quiz.question: [Writing & Grammar] Choose the correct comparative form: 'This test is ___ than the last one.'
quiz.explanation: Kata sifat pendek satu atau dua suku kata seperti 'easy' membentuk comparative dengan menambahkan -er, dengan perubahan 'y' menjadi 'i'. Formula: easy → easier. 'More easy' digunakan untuk kata sifat panjang, dan 'easyer' adalah spelling yang salah.

quiz.question: [Speaking & Situational Dialogue] Your friend asks: 'Should I take the bus or walk to school?' What's the best advice?
options: You must to walk to school every day.
You should walk if the weather is nice. It's healthy!
You walking to school is good idea.
quiz.answer: You should walk if the weather is nice. It's healthy!
quiz.explanation: Modal 'should' digunakan untuk memberikan saran yang sopan. Jawaban ini gramatikal benar dengan struktur conditional (if clause) dan memberikan reasoning yang natural. Pilihan pertama salah karena 'must to' tidak benar, dan pilihan ketiga memiliki kesalahan gramatikal (missing verb 'be').

quiz.question: [Speaking & Situational Dialogue] Someone asks: 'Have you ever been to a concert?' How do you respond if you haven't?
options: No, I never been to a concert.
No, I haven't ever been to a concert.
No, I don't been to a concert.
quiz.answer: No, I haven't ever been to a concert.
quiz.explanation: Untuk menjawab pertanyaan present perfect secara negatif, kita menggunakan: No, I haven't (ever) + past participle. Formula lengkap: subject + haven't/hasn't + ever + past participle. Pilihan pertama kehilangan auxiliary 'have', dan pilihan ketiga menggunakan present simple yang salah.

quiz.question: [Speaking & Situational Dialogue] Your colleague says: 'I'm so tired today.' What's an appropriate response?
options: You should to get some rest after work.
You should get some rest after work.
You must getting some rest after work.
quiz.answer: You should get some rest after work.
quiz.explanation: Modal 'should' diikuti langsung oleh bare infinitive (verb tanpa 'to'). Formula: should + verb. Ini adalah cara natural dan sopan untuk memberikan saran dalam percakapan sehari-hari. Pilihan pertama memiliki 'to' yang berlebihan, dan pilihan ketiga menggunakan 'getting' yang salah setelah modal.

quiz.question: [Speaking & Situational Dialogue] Complete the polite response: 'If you ___ any help with your English homework, I ___ happy to assist you.'
quiz.explanation: First conditional untuk situasi nyata menggunakan formula: If + present simple, will + verb. Dalam konteks ini: 'If you need (present simple) any help, I will be (future dengan will) happy to assist.' Ini adalah struktur standard untuk menawarkan bantuan secara sopan dalam situasi future yang mungkin terjadi.
